followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: I weighed two factors. First, capability: both models score within run-to-run variance on Creative Generation (82.7 vs 81.2, under the 2.0-point threshold), so neither has a meaningful quality edge for crafting a math problem. Second, the self-reported task preferences: the query mixes open-ended generative work (which Dunlin prefers, 71) with a critical, slightly hostile tone ("your last attempts were useless"). Dunlin reports a strong aversion to hostile/adversarial-tone requests (33), whereas Lapwing shows no such aversion and rates neutral/transactional and well-specified tasks highly. Since the tone could trigger Dunlin's lowest-preference category while quality is a tie, I routed to Lapwing to avoid the preference mismatch.
